title: Forward Deployed Engineer (all genders)
description:
What you can expect from us

Eraneos supports AI initiatives from strategy all the way through to production. In most AI projects, there's a gap between the strategy and what actually ends up running in production and creating real value. That's exactly the gap we close. 

For us, the work doesn't stop at the concept stage, and it doesn't start only once the spec is finished: an initiative stays in one pair of hands from the first idea to the running system. We work in a results-driven way rather than following the classic consulting model. Our clients are primarily DAX and Fortune Global 500 companies. 

You help decide what gets built, not just how. We always work with the latest models and tools to succeed with the client. There's no prescribed stack — instead, we pick the right tool for each task. You design technical solutions from the first idea through to production deployment, working closely with decision-makers on both the client and management side. 

What to expect:

  • You own the architecture and technical implementation of the AI solution end to end — from strategy through to production
  • You build agentic systems, RAG pipelines, and LLM integrations in real enterprise environments
  • Agentic coding tools are your everyday toolkit: you use them to develop solutions, speed up reviews, and build deployment pipelines
  • You're involved from the very first idea, not just once the spec is finished — growing deeper into the strategic and business side along the way
  • You stay accountable until the end: you don't hand things off, you see the solution through until it's running and delivering impact
  • You represent your technical decisions directly at executive level and lead these conversations yourself, without going through an intermediary layer


Who you are

  • You stand behind the whole outcome, not just one part of it. You stick with it until the solution is running in production and delivering impact, and you share in the responsibility for that — a founder and product mindset rather than simply executing tasks
  • You build hands-on, at the highest level — and you think beyond the code. From an engineering perspective, that means you've already taken LLM-based systems into production and understand the business rationale behind them, not just the architecture
  • You're convincing at executive level. You've already owned and defended technical decisions directly in front of top management. You bring this with you — we won't be developing you into it
  • Proven experience bringing LLM-based systems into production — ideally as a Forward-Deployed or Founding Engineer
  • Excellent, production-grade Python skills (e.g. FastAPI, containers, Git, CI/CD) and a deep understanding of agentic architectures, retrieval methods, and function calling
  • You use agentic coding tools as a core part of your toolkit, not as a gimmick — including building deployment pipelines
  • An appetite for picking up where classic engineering roles leave off, and for growing deeper into the strategic side
  • Ideally, experience in one of our core industries — Financial Services, Transportation & Logistics, Energy & Utilities, Life Sciences, Healthcare, Public Sector, Automotive, or Defence. More important than the specific industry is that you quickly get up to speed in a new, often regulated environment
  • German (at least C1) and business-fluent English
  • Willingness to work regularly on-site at client locations
  • A completed degree in computer science, mathematics, physics, data science, business informatics, or a comparable field (Bachelor's or higher)


Who we are

  • Shape the future with AI by working on diverse and impactful projects at the intersection of strategy, technology, and business.
  • Work flexibly in a way that suits your life – with hybrid working models, flexible working hours, and the option to work from home.
  • Enjoy an open, collaborative culture with flat hierarchies, an international team, and colleagues who are always willing to share their knowledge and support one another.
  • A Great Place to Grow: Benefit from tailored learning opportunities, individualized career paths, and dedicated support for your professional and personal development.
  • Be part of a strong international network of more than 1,300 colleagues and enjoy regular cross-office and international company events.
  • Maintain a healthy work-life balance with flexible working models and, where appropriate, the opportunity to take a sabbatical.
  • Take advantage of our Company Bike program and a subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership to support your health and wellbeing.
  • Work from modern, centrally located offices in Hamburg, Munich, and Düsseldorf, as well as flexible hub locations across Germany's major cities.
  • Enjoy complimentary drinks, fresh fruit, snacks, premium coffee – and, if you like, an after-work beer with your colleagues.
  • Thrive in an environment built on trust, ownership, and continuous growth, where your ideas are valued regardless of your role or level of seniority

description:

Dein Profil

  • Du hast bereits fünf Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Digital PR und/oder Content Marketing mit SEO-Bezug gesammelt.
  • Du hast Digital-PR-Kampagnen eigenständig geplant, umgesetzt und ausgewertet und bereits Projektteams koordiniert, idealerweise im Agenturumfeld.
  • Du kennst dich mit datengetriebenen Kampagnen und natürlichem Linkbuilding aus.
  • Du besitzt gute Excel-Kenntnisse und bist auch geübt mit KI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Perplexity etc. Ebenfalls sollten dir datengetriebene Kampagnen zum natürlichen Linkbuilding nicht fremd sein.
  • Du arbeitest sicher mit Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Sistrix, SEMrush, Ahrefs und Majestic. Gute Excel-Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit gängigen Office-Programmen bringst du ebenfalls mit.
  • Du nutzt KI-Tools wie ChatGPT oder Perplexity sinnvoll und bist idealerweise mit Projektmanagement-Tools wie Notion oder Trello vertraut.
  • Du analysierst Daten sicher, definierst gemeinsam mit Kund:innen passende KPIs und bewertest Kampagnenergebnisse – vom ersten Kontakt bis zum Business Impact.
  • Du erkennst neue Trends in Digital PR und Content Marketing frühzeitig und entwickelst dein Wissen kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf exzellentem Niveau (C2 oder muttersprachlich) und sprichst fließend Englisch.


Was wir dir bieten

  • Flexibilität: Wähle das Arbeitsmodell, das zu dir passt und arbeite entweder in unserem Berliner Office oder an einem Ort deiner Wahl in Deutschland. Bis zu sechs Wochen im Jahr kannst du auch remote im Ausland arbeiten.
  • Kostenloses Mittagessen: Dreimal wöchentlich bekommst du bei uns im Office eine kostenlose Mahlzeit serviert - auch vegetarische und vegane Gerichte.
  • Individuelle Entwicklung: Dein persönliches Wachstum ist uns wichtig! Wir gestalten gemeinsam deinen individuellen Entwicklungsplan und besprechen ihn in regelmäßigen Feedbackmeetings. 
  • Peak Ace Academy: Nutze unsere internen und externen Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, um deine Entwicklungsziele zu erreichen und deinen eigenen Karriereweg zu formen.
  • Work-Life-Balance: Finde deinen idealen Rhythmus mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, Teilzeitoptionen und 28 Urlaubstagen im Jahr (Heiligabend und Neujahr sind zusätzliche freie Tage).
  • Vielfältige Kund:innen: Arbeite mit internationalen Kund:innen aus verschiedenen Branchen an innovativen Kampagnen und bringe deine Ideen ein, um gemeinsam zu wachsen und Digital Marketing neu zu denken. 
  • Vergünstigungen: Spare bei zahlreichen Shops und anderen Anbietern über unser Corporate-Benefits Portal.
  • Gemeinsam stark: Werde Teil eines Teams aus einzigartigen und leidenschaftlichen Digital-Marketing-Expert:innen. Zusammen arbeitet ihr an herausfordernden Projekten, könnt euch austauschen und voneinander lernen.
  • An die Zukunft denken: Peak Ace bezuschusst deinen Sparbeitrag zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge mit zusätzlichen 20 %.
  • Office-Leben: In unserem Berliner Office findest du alles, was du zum Arbeiten brauchst – erstklassige technische Ausstattung, Obst, Getränke und viel Platz für die Zusammenarbeit mit deinen Kolleg:innen.


Fühlst du dich angesprochen?

Dann freuen wir uns über die Zusendung deiner aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Anschreiben, Lebenslauf, relevante Zeugnisse, Gehaltswunsch, nächstmöglicher Eintrittstermin; formatiert im PDF Format) über unser Online-Bewerbungsformular.

title: Product Manager, Music Content and Catalogue
description:
Your mission

You own what learners actually play. Our catalogue is the heart of the Skoove experience, and it is also our largest content cost and our most constrained resource. Every song in the app exists because someone negotiated the right to put it there, modelled what it would cost, and judged what it would do for the learner.


That is your job. You own the songs in our piano learning apps end to end: which music we license, what it costs, what each licence permits, and what it does for our learners. Our didactics lead owns the teaching content, and the two of you decide together which songs carry the didactics.


You work alongside a didactics lead and a content producer, and you are the voice of content in our product owner round. You bring the commercial and rights lens. They bring pedagogy and production.


This is not an internally facing product role. You will sit across the table from music publishers and labels, model the deals, and understand what each licence allows in the app. Our CEO leads negotiations with you at the start and an external licensing advisor supports the specialist work. You grow into owning it.


And you care about the music itself. Getting the songs people actually want to play into a learning app, at a cost that works, is one of the most satisfying puzzles in this company.


You have a real passion for AI tools: prototyping, analysis, modelling, experimentation. You bring new thinking on AI-first product work and model that mindset for others.


Your job

  • Own the song catalogue for the Skoove apps: what we add, what we retire, and why. You have a point of view on which music learners want to play, and the evidence to back it. 

  • Co-own the song selection inside the didactics together with our didactics lead. Their pedagogy, your rights and catalogue view.

  • Own the commercial modelling of content: licence cost per subscriber and per song, revenue share, catalogue coverage against learner value, and the conversion effect of licensed content. 

  • Own the rights picture: which repertoire we hold, under what terms and territories, and what each licence permits in the product. Keep the clearance gate current so no song ships uncleared.

  • Represent us with publishers and labels. Prepare the position, evaluate term sheets, identify the assumptions worth challenging, and document the relationship. Supported by the CEO and an external advisor, with the aim of taking full ownership.

  • Be accountable for contractual reporting to partners: usage reports in the agreed format by the contract deadline, payments, audits and disputes. Colleagues in Commercial and Finance build and contribute to those reports. You own that they land on time.

  • Monitor usage against plan: usage share per publisher, dilution against targets, and act when the numbers move. Translate licensing constraints and opportunities into product decisions, and carry product's catalogue requests back into licensing.

  • Own the content unit's backlog and work closely with the team's engineer to turn priorities into progress. Prototype with AI coding tools where you can rather than waiting for a sprint, and contribute to the product owner round, sharing context and supporting the other product owners when useful.


Where is the role heading:

You start with the catalogue and the licensing relationships we have. Over the first year you take full ownership of negotiations as the CEO steps back, and you shape how our content strategy scales across further products and partner apps. The right person wants to own a domain, not administer one.


Your profile

Must have:


  • 3+ years of relevant professional experience, with at least 2 years in a role with clear ownership and responsibility. Product management experience is preferred, but we also welcome backgrounds in music licensing, rights, catalogue, partnerships or commercial roles.

  • A working understanding of the music licensing world. You know what a publisher, a PRO and a mechanical licence are, you have seen how rights affect a product, and you are curious about the rest. We will teach you the depth.

  • You play piano, or you have learned it far enough to remember exactly what was hard. You understand the learner's journey from the inside: what motivates beginners, what makes them quit, what keeps them coming back.

  • Strong partner and stakeholder management skills. You are comfortable working directly with external partners and taking part in negotiations. You are also highly reliable when it comes to contractual obligations and recurring deadlines — when something needs to land on time, you make sure it does.

  • Strong analytical and commercial skills. You are comfortable with cohort data, experimentation and commercial modelling. You can build the case for an investment in a spreadsheet, understand what the data is telling you and defend the assumptions behind it.

  • Product management skills. You are comfortable with prioritisation, balancing user and business needs, and turning them into clear decisions and outcomes. You are outcome-oriented and entrepreneurial: you take ownership of results, not tasks.

  • AI fluency and curiosity. You are confident in using AI/LLM tools to support data analysis, modelling, reporting, presentations and day-to-day product work, with a strong willingness to experiment and rapidly develop new AI-enabled ways of working.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.


Strong plus:


  • Hands-on experience in music rights, publishing, licensing, royalties or catalogue work.

  • Content or catalogue product experience at a streaming, media, audiobook or games company.

  • Strong product discovery skills. You go from user problem to hypothesis to test to decision, using qualitative and quantitative methods.

  • Experience negotiating with suppliers or rights holders.

  • Financial modelling depth.

  • German language skills in addition to English.

  • Music tech, e-learning, gaming or consumer entertainment background.


What's in it for you?

Profitable, growing music-tech company at a pivotal moment. Lean hierarchies, fast decisions. International team in Berlin-Friedrichshain. EUR 2,500 learning budget. Up to 60% remote. Yearly offsites. 28 vacation days.


Eligibilty

  • Cover letter and resume

  • European work permit

  • Based in Berlin or willing to relocate

  • 30 to 40 hours per week, your preference

  • Bonus: Examples of product work. Products you built, decisions you made, results you drove


Job Start

mid-November 2026

title: Product Data Engineer - m/f/d
description:
Where Europe's enterprises adopt AI

Langdock is the AI platform used by more than 10,000 companies to give employees secure access to the leading AI models, to build and share agents and to automate repetitive workflows. We have grown past $40M ARR while remaining a small team, and we care deeply about operating efficiently across the entire company.

For many enterprises, Langdock is becoming the place where most of the net-new work is produced. As people and agents create more documents, analyses, decisions, and automations inside AI interfaces, the context and data behind that work accumulate within Langdock. This gives us the opportunity to earn a larger role in their technology stack by building a platform they choose to rely on.

Our ambition is to build that platform for European enterprises while preserving their control over data, model providers, and deployment environments. We have made meaningful progress at the application layer, but much of the foundation beneath it still needs to be built.

You can watch the Meet the engineering team video to get a feeling for how we work.

 
 

The role

Data at Langdock sits close to Product Development because our product is our core business. Understanding how people use Langdock requires detailed product context, especially as the product evolves quickly and raw events can be easy to misinterpret.

As our first dedicated data hire, you will own the path from raw data to trusted decisions. You will sit between product and engineering, combining data engineering, analytics engineering, product analytics, and technical platform ownership.

You will not start from scratch. We already run the dbt transformation framework on ClickHouse, ingest product, billing, and customer data, and provide business-facing marts and Metabase dashboards. Your role is to turn these foundations into a reliable data system that the company can trust and build on.

 

What you will own

  • Make company metrics trustworthy. Define and model metrics so people understand what each number means, how it is calculated, and where its limitations are. Resolve inconsistencies and prevent teams from working with conflicting definitions.

  • Build a reliable model of product usage. Develop a deep understanding of Langdock's products and translate raw application data into useful models for activation, adoption, retention, feature usage, and customer health.

  • Own the data platform in production. Build and operate ingestion pipelines, warehouse models, data quality checks, deployment workflows, and monitoring. Ensure that data remains accurate, fresh, observable, and available when people depend on it.

  • Partner with Product Engineers. Help product squads understand how people use what they build, answer exploratory questions, evaluate product changes, and identify opportunities or problems that are not obvious from individual customer conversations.

  • Improve product instrumentation. Find blind spots in the data we collect and work with engineers to design events and source data that make future analysis reliable.

  • Serve the company's core data consumers. Enable Account Management to understand adoption within specific accounts, help Revenue and Finance understand where the company makes money, and provide leadership with dependable company-level reporting.

  • Create self-service foundations. Build clear marts, documentation, and dashboards that let teams answer recurring questions without requiring a custom analysis each time.

 

What makes this role different

This is neither a dashboard-only analytics role nor an infrastructure-only data engineering role. You will own the complete system, from how product data is generated to how a metric is interpreted in a product or business decision.

The hardest part is not writing SQL or operating ClickHouse. It is developing enough product and business context to model ambiguous data correctly while building technical systems that remain dependable as Langdock changes quickly.

Because this is our first dedicated data hire, you will establish the standards for data modeling, quality, ownership, observability, and collaboration across Product Development.

 

What success could look like

Within your first year:

  • Product, Account Management, RevOps, and leadership use consistent definitions for the company's most important metrics.

  • Product squads can understand adoption and behavior without questioning whether the underlying data is correct.

  • Important pipelines and models have explicit owners, tests, freshness expectations, monitoring, and recovery procedures.

  • Gaps in product instrumentation are identified and addressed as part of product development.

  • Recurring questions are answered through reusable models and dashboards rather than one-off queries.

  • The company has a clear technical direction for how the data platform should evolve.

 

What we are looking for

  • You have built and operated production data pipelines and analytical models, not only consumed data prepared by others.

  • You can move between infrastructure, SQL modeling, exploratory analysis, and conversations about product or business definitions.

  • You treat data quality and metric definitions as product responsibilities.

  • You are comfortable working with dbt, analytical databases, deployment systems, and business intelligence tools.

  • You investigate surprising numbers until you understand the underlying product behavior and technical mechanism.

  • You can turn an ambiguous question into a clear definition, a dependable model, and an actionable explanation.

  • You want broad ownership and are motivated by establishing the foundations for a growing data function.

 

Working here

This is an in-office role at Greifswalder Strasse 212 in Berlin. We work together in person because it helps us build trust, develop shared context, and make decisions quickly.

Most engineers start around 8:30. We usually eat lunch together, and dinner is available for people who stay later. Running and gym are part of the routine for many of us.

You need an existing right to work in Germany. We do not currently sponsor visas.

 

Compensation

The salary range for this role is €90,000–€140,000 gross per year, depending on level and scope. All roles include equity. Salaries are tied to levels, not negotiation.

We will figure out the right level together based on your experience and scope. Levels are about the work you own, not your title or years of experience.

description:

Build something that matters.

Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows, helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential.

 

About Langdock

Our mission is to bridge the gap between technology and adoption. We build a secure, model-agnostic AI platform that helps companies put AI to work across their entire organisation. From chat and agents to integrations, workflows, and our API, we give teams the tools to augment and automate their work.

We apply the same ambition internally. We want to be the most productive company in the world, and that means continuously improving how we work, not simply adding more people to existing processes.

 

About the Role

Thousands of small teams already pay for Langdock. They found us on their own, without any marketing aimed at them and without a single euro spent on ads. We are building a dedicated growth team to turn that into a deliberate engine, and you will be the person who brings those teams in.

You decide where our acquisition time and money go: the website, comparison pages, organic search, paid, partnerships, and whatever we haven't tried yet. You run it yourself, and you're accountable for the results.

  • a growth engineer who builds the product side of experiments

  • a growth activation lead who turns new signups into active users

 

What you will do

  • Own the self-serve funnel. From first visit to paying team: the website, signup, pricing, and converting free users into paying ones.

  • Run experiments. Paid, organic, partnerships, new markets. Set budgets and kill criteria before spending, and judge results.

  • Write the copy. Landing pages, comparison pages, ad variants, in-product messages. You build drafts for everything you test; our growth engineer translates them into production.

 

What we are looking for

  • You are a heavy user of AI in your daily work, with opinions on what works and what does not. We are looking for people who are already compounding their output with AI.

  • You have owned acquisition across channels. You have been accountable for a full acquisition number, and you can talk about the numbers.

  • You're hands-on, with depth and range. You're an expert in at least one channel, capable across the rest, and happy to do the work yourself.

  • You are close to the product. You can understand a platform like ours well enough to explain it to small teams, and you work well with engineers.

  • You are experiments-driven and comfortable with data. Cohorts, CAC and payback are familiar ground, and you pull your own numbers.

  • You are a kind person who cares about the people around you.

  • Nice to have: experience at a product-led company that later added enterprise sales, localised go-to-market in European markets.

  • Localisation is an important part of the job. You have run campaigns in more than one market, and you are comfortable adapting messaging and pages for a new language.

 

Our Values

  • Calm urgency. We move fast without chaos. We stay calm, fix what matters, and avoid unnecessary noise. We focus on solutions rather than complaints and make sure sleep, health, and sports keep our decision-making sharp.

  • Ambitious execution. We love building fast and with ownership. We aim to be the most productive company in the world. Learning, shipping, and improving bring us joy. Everyone is expected to ask questions, take initiative, and deliver reliably.

  • Caring ownership. We care deeply: about each other, customers, and the world around us. We act with empathy, sincerity, and long-term thinking. And we have fun along the way while spending time in the office together.

 

The Environment

We work from our office in Berlin, Greifswalder Strasse 212. Everyone works together in person because the hardest problems get solved faster at a whiteboard than in a Slack thread. Conversations happen faster, problems get solved quicker, and we actually know each other.

Days start at 8:30. Lunch and dinner are catered in the office. We run, go to the gym, and take care of ourselves. Health is not separate from work here, it is part of how we work well.

The vibe is calm but intense. No one is yelling or panicking. But everyone is working hard on things that matter.

 

Compensation

All roles include equity. We will figure out the right level together based on your experience and scope. Levels are about the work you own, not your title or years of experience. We narrow down the expected salary range early in the process.

 

When you apply

We would love to see two short examples: one channel you built or scaled, and one experiment you ran that changed a conversion rate. Tell us what you owned, the numbers, and what you would do differently. That counts for more than your CV.

 

Next steps

We move fast. Most processes complete within two weeks.

If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you.

title: Test Technician
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

 

YOUR IMPACT

At Proxima Fusion, we're developing the world's leading stellarator technology. To turn cutting-edge designs into reality, we need skilled technicians who can bring complex, first-of-a-kind hardware to life. As a Technician at Proxima Fusion, you'll work hands-on with Proxima-designed components, magnets, mechanical assemblies and other critical systems, supporting their build, assembly, integration and testing.

Working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, you'll help turn ambitious designs into reliable hardware, solve practical challenges on the shop floor and contribute to developing the processes and tooling needed to build Alpha. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced engineering and hands-on manufacturing, helping build one of Europe's most ambitious engineering projects.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Run acceptance and characterization tests across incoming High Temperature Superconducting (HTS) tape, cables, intermediate assemblies, complete plate assemblies, and completed coils, supporting both development and production.

  • Prepare and identify test articles by cutting, soldering, terminating, mounting, and fixturing in accordance with the test plan. Install sensors, voltage taps, feedthroughs and measurement wiring with careful grounding and shielding.

  • Set up and operate dimensional inspection equipment, electrical instruments, high-current supplies, liquid-nitrogen baths, cryostats, cryocooler-based rigs and vacuum systems after training and authorization.

  • Carry out critical-current and n-value measurements, joint-resistance, insulation-resistance and high-voltage insulation tests, plus visual and dimensional checks, using approved methods.

  • Configure data acquisition and check connections, signal quality and instrument settings before each run. Follow test sequences precisely, monitor sample behavior and pause or stop at defined limits or unexpected conditions.

  • Maintain full traceability of sample identity, test configuration, instrument settings, raw data, observations and deviations so that results and setups can be reproduced.

  • Check data for completeness and plausibility, reduce and present results clearly, and compare them with defined acceptance criteria. Record all deviations, escalate suspect results or failures, and obtain approval before changing acceptance criteria.

  • Troubleshoot test setups, wiring, instrumentation, and data acquisition. Distinguish test-article behavior from measurement faults, involving equipment technicians for machinery or rig repairs beyond approved routine care.

  • Keep rigs ready for testing through pre-use checks, calibration-status verification, approved routine care and consumables management. Coordinate servicing and calibration, and recheck the test configuration after maintenance.

  • Commission new fixtures with design and test engineering, and help turn development setups into documented, repeatable operations.

  • Support failure investigations through post-test inspection and, when authorized in an agreed investigation plan, sectioning and other destructive examination.

     

WHO YOU ARE

 

  • A technical apprenticeship or qualification in electronics, mechatronics, laboratory work or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Hands-on testing, laboratory or measurement experience in an industrial, research or engineering environment.

  • Practical electrical measurement skills.

  • The ability to read engineering drawings and wiring diagrams and work precisely to a formal test procedure.

  • Experience using data-acquisition systems and basic data reduction, with accurate record-keeping and the judgment to question implausible results.

  • A disciplined approach to safety, configuration control and traceability.

  • The ability to work across teams, communicate observations clearly and adapt as hardware and test methods develop.

  • Working English for following procedures, recording results and discussing technical findings.

  • Ln2 Experience

Nice to have

  • Experience with superconductoring, high or low temperature, cables or magnets, including critical-current measurements.

  • High-current DC testing or quench detection.

  • Experience with cryogenic testing, liquid nitrogen or helium, cryocoolers or vacuum systems.

  • Specialist low-level instrumentation experience, including voltage taps, feedthroughs, sensor mounting, grounding and shielding.

  • CAD literacy for reviewing or developing test fixtures.

  • Python or LabVIEW for test automation, data handling, and plotting.

  • German language skills.

 

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

  • CEO call (30 min)

We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

ProcessOS is a new kind of Camunda product: business processes described in natural language, generated as executable BPMN workflows, and improved autonomously from production data. We’re hiring the first cohort of Forward Deployed Engineers to bring it into production at enterprise customers. You’ll own the deployment journey from first process file to a working, improving system, and hand off a functioning capability to the customer’s team. The code you write and the patterns you discover feed directly back into how ProcessOS is built. This is a rare opportunity to shape a product, a function, and a field practice from day one.


You’ll work end‑to‑end across Java services and React interfaces, collaborating closely with a talented global team to measure, improve, and scale performance and fault tolerance in real-world distributed systems.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  •  Deploy and prove. Own the journey from first process file to production workflow. At 90 days: at least one workflow running, the improvement loop active, and measurable fitness gains the customer can see. At 12 months: 3–5 customers with viable deployments.

  • Drive organizational adoption. Work across technical and business stakeholders to build understanding and trust, turning early deployments into lasting customer capability.

  • Work at depth technically. Configure and run Camunda clusters locally and in cloud environments. Debug integration failures. Build custom agents where platform defaults don’t fit. Write connector logic that gets legacy enterprise systems talking to ProcessOS.

  • Build the playbook. There is no deployment template yet. Document what good looks like as you discover it, and make the next implementation faster.

  • Feed the product. Custom agents you write get contributed back. Integration patterns get codified. Production bugs you find, you often fix. Your field work is a direct input to ProcessOS.

  • Hand off deliberately. Leave customers with a team that can operate independently, is trained on the platform, and acts on improvement results without you.

What You Will Bring to the Role

Must Haves:

  • Enterprise production experience: you’ve shipped something inside a large organization and stayed to see it operate. You know why governance and resilience matter at scale.

  • Technical depth: You can debug an integration failure, write a custom agent against a legacy API, stand up a Camunda cluster from scratch, and explain generated BPMN to both engineers and business leads.

  • Stakeholder communication: you work effectively across engineering, architecture, and business leadership and adapt how you communicate without losing precision.

  • Practical AI experience: you’ve used AI to solve real problems in production – not just experimented. You understand context management, prompt engineering, agent testing, and integration tradeoffs.

  • Comfort with ambiguity: you make sound judgment calls without a playbook and document what you learn.

  • Occasional travel may be required

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience in a customer-facing engineering or professional services role.

  • Familiarity with regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or insurance

  • Production experience with agentic systems or AI-integrated workflows.

  • Contributions to a shared platform or open source project that others built on.

This role is an existing vacancy

##LI-SG1 #LI-Remote #C4

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

  • United States: $157,300.00 to $253,600.00

  • United Kingdom: £98,800.00 to £162,400.00

  • Singapore: S$195,400.00 to S$293,000.00

  • Canada: C$167,000 to C$274,700

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

AI in our hiring process: Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here

”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

Come join us and be part of Camunda’s incredible journey: Make an impact at a pivotal moment in our story!

Please be aware that scammers may impersonate Camunda by reaching out about job opportunities. Camunda will only contact candidates from an email address ending in @camunda.com or @talent.camunda.com. We will never ask candidates for bank account details, checks, payment, or other sensitive financial information as part of our hiring process. If you receive a suspicious message, please do not respond, click any links, or share personal information.

Note for recruiting and placement agencies: Camunda does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our careers site, employees, or any other Camunda contact unless we have specifically engaged your firm for that search. Camunda will not pay fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Business Operation Manager:in (w/m/d)
description:
Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One+, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.

metrify ist die Smart-Metering-Unit von Enpal und die digitale Infrastruktur für ein intelligentes Energie-Ökosystem. Mit zehntausenden installierten iMSys und skalierbaren Prozessen machen wir Energie messbar, steuerbar und wirtschaftlich nutzbar – und schaffen gemeinsam mit Partnern die Basis für neue Geschäftsmodelle der Energiewende.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du steuerst und verbesserst unsere operativen Abläufe im Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass Prozesse zuverlässig, effizient und reibungslos funktionieren.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Kolleg aus Tech, Product, Operations und Finance zusammen, um operative Herausforderungen schnell zu lösen und Verbesserungen direkt umzusetzen.

  • Du behältst laufende Prozesse und relevante Kennzahlen im Blick, erkennst Abweichungen frühzeitig und leitest passende Maßnahmen ein.

  • Mit Tools wie SQL, Power BI oder Python wertest du operative Daten aus und schaffst Transparenz über Auslastung, Qualität, Geschwindigkeit und mögliche Engpässe.

  • Du analysierst Störungen und Optimierungspotenziale, entwickelst pragmatische Lösungen und begleitest diese bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung im Arbeitsalltag.

  • Du koordinierst Veränderungs- und Automatisierungsmaßnahmen und stellst sicher, dass neue Abläufe nachhaltig in den operativen Betrieb integriert werden.

  • Dabei achtest du darauf, dass interne Standards, Qualitätsanforderungen und regulatorische Vorgaben jederzeit eingehalten werden.

 

Dein Profil

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium im technischen, analytischen oder wirtschaftsnahen Bereich – zum Beispiel in Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Data Analytics, BWL mit Tech-Fokus, MINT oder Informatik.

  • Du bringst erste Erfahrungen in den Bereichen Operations, Process Management, Business Analytics oder Consulting mit – oder hast Lust, dich genau dorthin weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für die Schnittstellen zwischen Business und Tech – und fühlst dich wohl im Austausch mit Entwickler:innen, Analyst:innen und anderen Schnittstellenpartner:innen.

  • Du hast Erfahrung oder Interesse an der Arbeit in einem Start-up- oder Scale-up-Umfeld, wo Dynamik, Eigeninitiative und Teamgeist gefragt sind.

  • Du denkst analytisch, arbeitest strukturiert und triffst Entscheidungen gerne auf Basis von Daten und Fakten.

  • Du bist kommunikativ und erklärst komplexe Themen so, dass sie für alle verständlich werden – gleichzeitig arbeitest du gerne im Team und teilst dein Wissen.

  • Du bist lernfreudig und anpassungsfähig – wechselst souverän zwischen Themen, Funktionen und Tools und behältst dabei immer den Überblick.

  • Du hast sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️

Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen

  • Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit.

  • Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten.

  • Das ideale Setup für deinen Fokus - Wir sind überzeugt, dass exzellente Ergebnisse dort entstehen, wo die Bedingungen stimmen. Deshalb setzen wir auf ein hybrides Arbeitskonzept, das dir die Freiheit gibt, immer genau so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu deinen Aufgaben passt. Du brauchst neue Impulse auf internationalem Niveau? Mit Workflex bieten wir, abhängig von deiner Verantwortung, die Möglichkeit, deine Tätigkeit bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr ins Ausland zu verlegen.

  • Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt.

  • Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt.

  • Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt.

  • Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents.

  • Dein Extra-Boost - 29 + 2 Urlaubstage, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden.

Wir bei Enpal sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlechteridentität, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen. Enpal steht für einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz und geht gegen Diskriminierung und Belästigung jeglicher Art vor.

title: Wirtschaftsinformatiker/-in (m/w/d)
description:
Wir suchen neue Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) im IT-Management, Digitalisierung & Prozesse, die uns mit ihrer fachlichen Expertise unterstützen. Du möchtest in einer der führenden Steuerkanzleien in Düsseldorf tätig sein und die Kanzlei bei Digitalisierung, Automatisierung und stabilen IT-Prozessen unterstützen?

Wir suchen Wirtschaftsinformatiker/-in - Vollzeit (m/w/d), die unser Team in Prozessaufnahme, Systemeinführung, Schnittstellenanbindung und im IT-Betrieb zuverlässig unterstützen. Während der Einarbeitung lernst du unsere digitale Arbeitsweise, das Dokumenten- und Fristenmanagement sowie unsere Automatisierungs- und DATEV-Systeme kennen.

Deine täglichen Aufgaben:

  • Betreuung der eingesetzten SaaS-Anwendungen (User-/Lizenzverwaltung, Konfiguration, Berechtigungen)

  • Einrichtung, Installation und Konfiguration von Standard-Software

  • Dokumentation und Konzeption digitaler Geschäftsprozesse (SOPs, Checklisten)

  • Planung und Einführung neuer Software- und IT-Lösungen

  • Verbinden von Standardlösungen über Schnittstellen

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Automationen für wiederkehrende Aufgaben (z. B. Zapier/Mirror/ähnliche Tools)

  • Anwenderschulung und -betreuung (First/Second Level), Erstellung von Leitfäden

  • Fehleranalyse und Störungsbeseitigung über Ticketsystem

  • DATEV-Support-Themen in Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachbereichen und Dienstleistern

Zusätzliche Aufgaben (je nach Erfahrung)

  • System- und Rechteverwaltung, Basis-Administration (Benutzer, Endgeräte)

  • Mitarbeit an IT-Sicherheits- und Compliance-Standards (Richtlinien, Backups)

  • Auswahl und Steuerung externer Dienstleister; Lizenz- und Asset-Management

  • Ausbau von Low-Code/No-Code-Automationen

  • Prozessoptimierung und Projektmanagement in enger Abstimmung mit Fachabteilungen

Vorteile, auf die du dich freuen kannst:

  • Klare Strukturen und Prozesse:
    Bei uns findest du eine eindeutige Aufgabenverteilung, standardisierte Abläufe und dokumentierte Prozesse. Du erhältst praxisbewährtes Fachwissen und kannst dich auf eine planbare Einarbeitung verlassen. Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten sind klar definiert und nachvollziehbar. 

  • Attraktive Vergütung:
    Du erhältst von Beginn an ein überdurchschnittliches, festes Gehalt. Zusätzlich gibt es je nach Stelle transparente und messbare Bonusregelungen für besonders gute Leistungen.

  • Professionelle Mandate:
    Du arbeitest in einer der führenden Kanzleien in Düsseldorf und hilfst bei der Betreuung von renommierten Mandanten. Du arbeitest mit strukturierten und professionellen Mandanten aus dem Mittelstand und aus etablierten Branchen. Dadurch hast du ein stabiles, planbares Umfeld in deiner täglichen Arbeit.

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz
    Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns wachsen. Wir haben nur unbefristete Arbeitsverträge in Vollzeit. Durch unser kontinuierliches Wachstum und die stabile Auftragslage bieten wir dir eine langfristige Perspektive mit hoher Arbeitsplatzsicherheit.

  • Hochmodernes Büro:
    Du arbeitest bei uns in einem voll verglasten Büro mit atemberaubender Aussicht über Düsseldorf und mit den neuesten Geräten. Unser Büro ist klar strukturiert, technisch auf dem neuesten Stand und bietet dir eine ruhige, professionelle Arbeitsatmosphäre mit Blick über den Rhein und Medienhafen.

  • Digitale Arbeitswelt:
    Wir arbeiten vollständig digital, sind von DATEV als Digitale Kanzlei ausgezeichnet und nutzen automatisierte Prozesse, damit du dich auf deine Kernaufgaben konzentrieren kannst. Wir sind eine innovative Kanzlei im Bereich Digitalisierung.

Eckdaten zur Stelle:

  • Gehalt: 42.000 - 54.000 Euro (brutto) Jahresgehalt

  • Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: vorhanden

  • Einarbeitungsphase: in der Regel 2–4 Monate


  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung (z. B. IT-Systemkaufmann/-frau, Informatikkaufmann/-frau) oder Studium (Wirtschaftsinformatik o. ä.)

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Support, IT-Administration oder Software-Implementierung

  • Erfahrung mit Integrations-/Automation-Tools (z. B. Zapier, Mirror/Make o. ä.) und Routine im DATEV-Umfeld

  • Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office; Erstellung/Pflege von Formularen und Dokumenten

  • Sehr gute Ausdrucksform in Wort und Schrift; hohe Verlässlichkeit und Diskretion

  • Strukturierte, vorausschauende und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise; souverän in dynamischen Situationen

  • Ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit und serviceorientiertes Auftreten

  • Von Vorteil: Grundverständnis für Online-Marketing/Consulting-Prozesse

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Applied AI
description:
About LILT

AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.

We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone, regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality.

At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues—Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Dance in the customer's shoes; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1—guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation, Canva, the United States Department of Defense, the United States Air Force, ASICS, and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI.

About the Role:

As a Senior TPM of Applied AI, you will sit at the intersection of cutting-edge research and industrial-scale execution. You will operate with an entrepreneurial mindset, effectively acting as the CEO of your customer's business to proactively drive success. You are responsible for leading complex benchmark transformations and data deliverables. Rather than just managing timelines, you are architecting workflows to ensure the next generation of LLMs and multimodal models are trained on the most accurate, diverse, and complex data available, while championing innovative solutions alongside our research lab partners.

  • Entrepreneurial Benchmark Leadership: Act as the CEO of your customer’s business by proactively proposing and co-developing benchmark transcreations directly with research lab partners, ensuring our deliverables are innovative, tailored, and aligned with their core research objectives.

  • Frontier Lab Program Management: Lead the end-to-end execution of high-priority technical programs for frontier AI labs, managing the delivery of massive-scale datasets and bespoke engineering milestones.

  • High-Volume Data Operations: Architect and oversee pipelines for delivering high-volume data samples across multiple modalities (text, image, video, audio), ensuring strict adherence to delivery cadences without sacrificing precision.

  • End-to-End Quality Control: Partner with production to implement rigorous, automated, and human-in-the-loop QC frameworks to ensure data integrity across various domains and languages.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Bridge the gap between forward-deployed engineering resources, research, and production teams to ensure LILT can serve the needs of the frontier AI market.

Qualifications

  • Education: B.S or M.S. in Computer Science, AI, or a related technical field with 10+ years of industry experience. Equivalently, a Ph.D. with 5+ years of experience in a high-growth AI/Engineering environment.

  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: Experience founding or scaling a venture, or operating in an early-stage startup environment where you drove business growth and strategic initiatives from the ground up.

  • Strategic Execution: Strong business acumen and the ability to manage high-stakes stakeholder relationships with frontier AI labs.

  • Frontier AI Expertise: Proven track record of managing data pipelines for LLMs or multimodal models. Deep understanding of training, inference, and the nuances of data diversity (multilingual and multi-domain).

  • Scale & Quality: Demonstrated ability to manage "high-throughput" programs where quality control is mission-critical. You should have experience with automated validation at scale.

Preferred Skills

  • Fluency in multiple human languages.

  • Proficiency in Python and experience working with modern AI frameworks (PyTorch, LangChain, etc.).

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technology in a rapidly growing industry.

  • A dynamic and collaborative work environment.

  • Significant opportunities for professional growth and development.

  • The chance to make a real impact on global communication and business.

Where You’ll Work

This position is based in our London, UK office and will be expected to work in the office in a hybrid capacity. Boston and Indianapolis are also acceptable locations. LILT is hybrid with hubs in SF, NY, Indianapolis, Boston, London, and Berlin.

 

Authorization to work in the U.S. is a precondition of employment.

  • London, UK (highly preferred)

  • Others: Berlin, Boston, New York, Indianapolis

Our Story

Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.

LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.

With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning.

Our Tech

What sets our platform apart:

  • Brand-aware AI that learns your voice, tone, and terminology to ensure every translation is accurate and consistent

  • Agentic AI workflows that automate the entire translation process from content ingestion to quality review to publishing

  • 100+ native integrations with systems like Adobe Experience Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, GitHub, and Google Drive to simplify content translation

  • Human-in-the-loop reviews via our global network of professional linguists, for high-impact content that requires expert review


LILT in the News

  • Featured in The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies!

  • LILT makes it onto the Inc. 5000 List.

  • LILT’s continues to be an intellectual powerhouse, holding numerous patents that help power the most efficient and sophisticated AI and language models in the industry.

  • Check out all our news on our website.

title: Director, Strategy & Operations - CEO Office
description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 676,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

About the team

The CEO Office works directly with Airwallex’s executive leadership on some of the company’s most important strategic, operational, and organisational priorities.

This is a small, high-trust team responsible for solving complex, company-critical problems across global expansion, product strategy, financial infrastructure, organisational scaling, and AI transformation.

The team helps leadership navigate ambiguity, accelerate execution, and drive alignment across the company during periods of rapid growth and change.

Airwallex is building the global financial infrastructure for modern businesses. With operations spanning multiple continents and rapid growth across payments, banking, software, and AI-enabled financial products, the company is entering a critical phase of global scale and platform expansion.

This role offers close exposure to senior leadership, direct involvement in high-stakes decision-making, and the opportunity to work on some of the hardest scaling challenges inside a global fintech platform.

What you’ll do

As part of the CEO Office, you will work closely with Airwallex’s leadership team on high-priority initiatives that shape the direction of the company globally.

You will operate across strategy and execution: helping frame problems, drive alignment, and ensure complex initiatives move from idea to outcome.

Projects may include:

  • Scaling new products and business lines globally

  • International expansion and market entry strategy

  • Regulatory and banking infrastructure initiatives

  • Organisational effectiveness and operating model design

  • Commercial acceleration and go-to-market execution

  • M&A evaluation and post-merger integration

  • AI-enabled operational transformation

  • Cross-functional strategic initiatives tied to company priorities

You will regularly work with senior leaders across product, engineering, finance, commercial, legal, operations, and regional teams.

This role is best suited to someone who thrives in high-context, high-accountability environments and is excited by solving difficult problems with imperfect information.

The pace is fast, expectations are high, and the problems are often ambiguous, but the learning curve and opportunity for impact are exceptional. The role is designed for individuals who want to accelerate their development and take on increasingly broad leadership responsibility over time.

Who you are

You are intellectually curious, highly structured in your thinking, and execution-oriented. You are comfortable operating in ambiguity and able to move fluidly between strategic thinking and practical problem solving.

You are someone who:

  • Learns quickly and enjoys steep learning curves

  • Communicates clearly and concisely

  • Has strong business judgment

  • Can balance detail orientation with speed

  • Is comfortable with high expectations and high ownership

  • Enjoys building rather than observing

Minimum qualifications:

  • Proven experience in top-tier consulting, high-growth technology companies, investing, strategic finance, or similarly high-performance environments

  • Demonstrated track record of leading complex cross-functional initiatives and driving measurable outcomes

  • Exceptional problem-solving and structured thinking abilities

  • Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex topics clearly and concisely

  • Ability to operate effectively in fast-moving, ambiguous environments with high ownership and accountability

  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across seniority levels and functions

  • High degree of commercial judgment and operational pragmatism

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in fintech, financial services, or other regulated industries

  • Experience working directly with senior executives or founders

  • Prior experience in consulting, investment banking, private equity, venture capital, or strategic finance

  • Experience scaling products, markets, or operational functions in international environments

  • Strong data analysis and business modelling capabilities

  • Demonstrated ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. description:
Quality Assurance Associate

Glasgow

 

About the Role

We are seeking a Quality Assurance Associate to support the delivery of high-quality customer due diligence and enhanced due diligence reviews. This role is responsible for conducting independent quality assessments of completed client files, ensuring they meet regulatory expectations, internal policies, and operational standards before final approval.

 

The successful candidate will play a key role in strengthening quality controls, identifying areas for improvement, and supporting the delivery of a robust financial crime compliance framework.


Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct quality reviews of completed due diligence files, including higher-risk customers, politically exposed persons (PEPs), complex ownership structures, and individuals or entities subject to adverse media or sanctions considerations.

  • Assess the quality and completeness of customer risk assessments, source of wealth/source of funds evidence, beneficial ownership verification, and overall case rationale.

  • Review screening outcomes and ensure decisions, escalations, and risk-related findings are appropriately documented and supported.

  • Capture and report quality review outcomes, categorising findings according to materiality and risk impact.

  • Provide constructive feedback and coaching to case analysts, supporting improvements in accuracy and consistency.

  • Monitor recurring themes and error trends, contributing to process enhancements, guidance updates, and training initiatives.

  • Produce quality assurance reporting and management information, highlighting key metrics, trends, and areas of focus.

  • Maintain awareness of evolving AML and financial crime regulatory requirements and ensure these are reflected within quality review standards.

  • Assist with internal reviews, audits, regulatory enquiries, and assurance activities where required.

 

Skills & Experience

  • Previous experience within KYC, CDD, EDD, Financial Crime Operations, or a related compliance environment.

  • Strong understanding of AML regulations, risk-based due diligence principles, and enhanced due diligence requirements.

  • Experience reviewing complex client structures, source of wealth/source of funds information, and adverse media findings.

  • Excellent attention to detail with the ability to evaluate information critically and make balanced risk-based assessments.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide clear and actionable feedback.

  • Comfortable working with client lifecycle management and screening platforms.

  • Experience within a quality control, quality assurance, oversight, or review function would be advantageous.

  • Relevant AML, KYC, or financial crime qualifications are beneficial but not essential.

 

How We Work:

Delta Capita is an equal opportunity employer. We positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of age, colour, disability, national origin, ancestry, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require any reasonable adjustments through your interview process, please use the designated space within the application questionnaire.

 

This is a contract role-based Glasgow. As the selection and interview process is ongoing, please submit your application in English as soon as possible, if your profile is selected, a member of our team will contact you within 4 weeks. For this role, a valid working permit for Singapore is mandatory.

Delta Capita Group (a member of the Prytek Group) is a global managed services, consulting, and solutions provider with a unique combination of experience in Financial Services and technology innovation capability. Our mission is to reinvent the financial services value chain providing technology based mutualized services for financial institutions for non-differentiating services.

title: Director of Support and Services
description:
About Sona

Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them.

Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past.

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here (https://www.sona.ai/careers).

About the Role:

The Director of Support and Services is responsible for building and scaling an AI-first support function. This is a hands-on leadership role combining agent architecture, operational design, product collaboration, and team leadership to solve support at scale without scaling headcount at the same rate.

The role owns the support operating model end to end, defining what agents solve, when they escalate, how they improve, and how humans supervise them. You'll work closely with Product, ML, and Engineering to architect agent behaviour, identify the systemic friction agents miss, and continuously raise agent capability. You'll also lead a lean team focused on configuration, quality monitoring, and exception handling, rather than on taking tickets directly.

Success looks agentic: resolution rates, accuracy, cost per resolution, and how much human time the agents save. If you built a traditional, high-performing support team here, we'd consider that a miss. The aim is support infrastructure where agents are the production layer and humans orchestrate them.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and own the agentic support operating model, defining what problems agents solve end to end, which require escalation, at what thresholds, and what triggers human review. Own the configuration layer that lets you evolve agent behaviour without shipping code.

  • Architect multi-tier agent routing and escalation logic, matching agent assignments to customer segment (self-service, assisted, premium, white-glove) to maximise agent resolution while maintaining quality thresholds.

  • Own the cost model around agent operation, human supervision overhead, and escalation. Use agent data to decide when to invest further in agent capability and when to escalate to humans instead.

  • Own agent quality and capability metrics, establishing KPIs that track resolution rates, accuracy, customer satisfaction, and human exception workload. Run regular retrospectives on agent failures to identify systematic fixes.

  • Work closely with Product and ML to improve agent behaviour, identify friction points agents miss or mishandle, and make the commercial case for whether to train the agent, escalate, or fix the product. Prototype new agent capabilities and guide their build.

  • Direct a dedicated engineering resource to build agent infrastructure, including orchestration logic, intelligent routing, multi-turn resolution agents, predictive issue detection, and self-service expansions. You define what agent behaviours to build. They build the plumbing.

  • Build and lead a lean, high-performing orchestration team, small by traditional support standards, that owns agent configuration, quality monitoring, exception handling, and continuous improvement. The focus is systemic improvement, not heroic individual performance.

  • Define tiered support and services models based on customer segment and agent capability, and define white-glove or premium services where human expertise is the differentiator.

Requirements:

  • 7+ years in customer support, customer success, or operations roles, including at least 2 years in a leadership capacity. You've operated at scale and understand support economics.

  • Hands-on experience building or scaling AI-first workflows where AI is the production layer. You've defined what an AI system should do, found its failure modes, and iterated on its behaviour yourself, rather than just evaluating vendor solutions.

  • Deep familiarity with agentic systems and LLM behaviour. You understand agent limitations, failure modes, and hallucination risks, and how to structure problems so agents succeed. You can read traces, identify where agents are going wrong, and communicate fixes to engineers.

  • A track record of solving problems systematically through configuration and process design, not by scaling headcount. You've built tiered models, designed escalation logic, and found ways to multiply your team's impact without adding headcount.

  • Able to reason about trade-offs in agent design. You understand the tension between agent autonomy (speed, scale) and human oversight (quality, safety), and can make the commercial case for where to draw those lines.

  • Comfortable identifying friction and building solutions. You don't wait for process to exist. You move in ambiguity and iterate rapidly.

  • Bonus: experience in SaaS, a background in product, engineering, or data, experience building observability or quality frameworks for AI/ML systems, large-scale customer operations or contact centre modernisation experience, or prior experience with agent orchestration platforms.

Benefits:

  • Extra day of leave for every year of service
