title: Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager
description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager to join our Customer Experience team at Pleo. In this role, you’ll own a portfolio of large, complex, and strategically important enterprise customers, helping them achieve measurable business outcomes, expand adoption, manage change, and build long-term value with Pleo.

You’ll serve as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders while coordinating the broader Pleo relationship across Customer Success, Product, Support, Sales, Finance, and other internal teams.

This is not a reactive account-management role. You’ll be expected to understand each customer’s business priorities, operating model, success criteria, and risk profile. You’ll turn that understanding into clear success plans, executive engagement strategies, adoption programs, renewal plans, and growth opportunities.

The right candidate will bring at least three years of direct experience managing enterprise customers, along with the communication skills, commercial judgment, and operational discipline required to manage high-value relationships in a fast-paced technology environment.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Manager of Customer Success, Large & High-Growth Customers and work closely with teams across:

  • Customer Support

  • Customer Onboarding

  • Sales and Account Management

  • Product and Product Operations

  • Revenue Operations

  • Finance

  • Data and Analytics

  • Program Management and Operations

You’ll work with customer stakeholders across finance, procurement, operations, technology, transformation, and executive leadership.

You’ll be responsible for creating alignment across these stakeholders, establishing clear governance, and ensuring Pleo remains connected to the customer’s evolving strategic and operational priorities.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you will:

  • Own a portfolio of enterprise customers with accountability for customer health, value realisation, adoption, retention, renewal readiness, advocacy, and growth.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior and executive stakeholders, positioning yourself as a credible advisor who understands their business priorities and operating environment.

  • Develop detailed customer success plans that connect the customer’s strategic goals to measurable outcomes, adoption milestones, responsibilities, and timelines.

  • Lead executive business reviews and strategic customer meetings that demonstrate value, address risks, align stakeholders, and create clear next steps.

  • Drive product adoption across complex customer organisations, helping customers expand usage across teams, entities, locations, use cases, and workflows.

  • Create and maintain detailed stakeholder maps, identifying decision-makers, champions, influencers, operational contacts, blockers, and executive sponsors.

  • Identify churn risk early using product usage, engagement, stakeholder, support, financial, organisational, and external business signals.

  • Build and execute churn-prevention plans with clear actions, owners, timelines, customer commitments, and executive escalation paths.

  • Maintain detailed and accurate forecasts across renewals, risk, customer health, expected outcomes, growth opportunities, and major account milestones.

  • Lead renewal-readiness activities by ensuring customer value is documented, risks are addressed, stakeholders are aligned, and commercial partners have accurate account intelligence.

  • Identify and support expansion opportunities by connecting additional Pleo capabilities, products, or use cases to the customer’s evolving business needs.

  • Coordinate complex customer escalations across Support, Product, Engineering, Finance, and other teams while maintaining clear and confident customer communication.

  • Act as the customer’s internal advocate, ensuring customer needs, feedback, risks, and opportunities are visible to the right stakeholders at Pleo.

  • Navigate customer change effectively, including leadership transitions, reorganisations, acquisitions, market expansion, platform changes, and evolving business priorities.

  • Track customer commitments and outcomes with strong operational discipline, ensuring actions are documented, owned, and completed.

  • Contribute to the evolution of Pleo’s enterprise Customer Success model by sharing best practices, customer insights, playbooks, and recommendations.

  • Support peer development and knowledge sharing across the Customer Success team without holding direct people-management responsibility.

To put things into context

In this role, you can expect to work on priorities such as:

  • strengthening relationships with Pleo’s largest and most strategic customers

  • improving enterprise customer retention and renewal predictability

  • increasing adoption across complex customer organisations

  • creating stronger executive engagement and governance

  • identifying churn risk before it becomes a renewal issue

  • improving forecast accuracy and account visibility

  • coordinating complex customer needs across multiple internal teams

  • helping customers quantify and communicate the value they receive from Pleo

  • identifying opportunities for expansion and deeper product adoption

  • improving the consistency and quality of enterprise success planning

  • helping customers navigate operational and organisational change

  • turning customer feedback into actionable Product and CX insight

You can expect to work across a technology environment that includes CRM, Customer Success platforms, support systems, product analytics, business intelligence tools, workflow tools, and collaboration platforms.

Examples may include Vitally, Gainsight or similar, Zendesk, Looker, Tableau or Power BI, Jira, Asana, and Slack.

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • At least three years of direct enterprise Customer Success or strategic account-management experience, managing large, complex, and high-value B2B customers.

  • Five or more years of overall experience in Customer Success, account management, consulting, implementation, or a related customer-facing role.

  • Experience working in SaaS, fintech, enterprise technology, or another complex B2B technology environment.

  • A proven record of retaining and growing enterprise customers, including managing renewals, adoption, risk, and value realisation.

  • Strong executive relationship-management skills, with the confidence and credibility to engage senior decision-makers and business leaders.

  • Experience managing complex stakeholder environments involving multiple teams, business units, regions, entities, or decision-makers.

  • Strong churn-prediction and prevention skills, including the ability to interpret customer signals, identify root causes, and build effective recovery plans.

  • Detailed forecasting experience across renewals, customer risk, account health, adoption, and expansion opportunities.

  • Strong commercial judgment, with an understanding of how customer outcomes connect to retention, revenue, expansion, and long-term account value.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to lead difficult conversations, present to executives, and simplify complex issues.

  • Experience building strategic success plans, account plans, stakeholder maps, and executive business reviews.

  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret customer data, product usage, service trends, and business information.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to align internal stakeholders without relying on direct authority.

  • A structured and proactive approach to account management, with excellent follow-through and attention to detail.

  • Comfort working in a fast-paced growth environment where customer expectations, internal priorities, and business needs can evolve quickly.

  • The ability to balance strategic relationship management with detailed operational execution.

Nice to have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, spend management, financial operations, or expense-management technology

  • Experience working with finance leaders, procurement teams, controllers, CFO organisations, or transformation leaders

  • Experience managing multi-country or multinational enterprise customers

  • Familiarity with ERP, accounting, procurement, or financial-system integrations

  • Experience supporting customers through significant organisational or technology transformation

  • Exposure to AI-enabled Customer Success, predictive health models, automated risk detection, or digital engagement

  • Experience partnering with Product teams on strategic customer feedback and roadmap discussions

  • Experience managing accounts with complex security, compliance, governance, or implementation requirements

Why is this role a good fit for you?

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You enjoy building strategic relationships with complex enterprise customers.

  • You are comfortable engaging senior leaders and navigating high-stakes customer situations.

  • You know how to connect product adoption to measurable customer outcomes.

  • You are proactive about identifying and addressing churn risk.

  • You combine strong relationship skills with rigorous account-management discipline.

  • You are confident leading executive reviews, renewal discussions, and difficult customer conversations.

  • You enjoy coordinating internal teams around complex customer needs.

  • You want direct responsibility for protecting and growing some of Pleo’s most important customer relationships.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You have not directly managed enterprise or strategic customer relationships.

  • You prefer transactional or high-volume customer portfolios.

  • You are uncomfortable owning customer risk, retention, and renewal readiness.

  • You prefer reacting to customer requests rather than building proactive engagement strategies.

  • You are uncomfortable engaging executive stakeholders or leading difficult conversations.

  • You do not enjoy detailed forecasting, CRM management, and account planning.

  • You prefer working independently without significant cross-functional coordination.

  • You are looking for a people-management role rather than a senior individual-contributor position.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 1 month at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Learn Pleo’s product, enterprise customer journey, value proposition, and Customer Success operating model.

  • Build a detailed understanding of your customer portfolio, including revenue, renewal dates, usage, stakeholders, open issues, risks, and growth potential.

  • Establish relationships with key customer stakeholders and internal account partners.

  • Review and improve success plans, stakeholder maps, account plans, and risk assessments.

  • Establish clear operating rhythms for customer engagement, internal coordination, and forecasting.

  • Identify immediate risks, adoption gaps, and opportunities across your portfolio.

In your first 3 months, you’ll:

  • Lead consistent executive and operational engagement across your customer portfolio.

  • Improve customer success planning, value documentation, and renewal readiness.

  • Strengthen the accuracy and detail of customer health and renewal forecasts.

  • Deliver measurable progress against adoption, engagement, and customer outcome goals.

  • Build and execute mitigation plans for at-risk customers.

  • Identify and support qualified expansion opportunities.

  • Become a trusted advisor to customer stakeholders and a reliable source of account intelligence internally.

In your first 5 months, you’ll:

  • Build a healthy and well-managed portfolio of enterprise customers.

  • Deliver strong retention and renewal performance.

  • Improve adoption and value realisation across complex customer organisations.

  • Develop trusted relationships with senior and executive customer stakeholders.

  • Demonstrate strong forecast accuracy and proactive risk management.

  • Contribute repeatable best practices and insight to Pleo’s broader enterprise Customer Success model.

  • Be recognised as a senior individual contributor capable of managing Pleo’s most important and complex customer relationships.

Success in this role looks like

  • Enterprise customers have clear success plans connected to measurable business outcomes.

  • Executive and operational customer relationships are strong and multi-threaded.

  • Customer risks are identified early and addressed through structured mitigation plans.

  • Renewal forecasts are detailed, accurate, and supported by clear account evidence.

  • Customers demonstrate stronger product adoption and value realisation.

  • Escalations are managed with urgency, clarity, and strong customer communication.

  • Internal teams are aligned around customer priorities, responsibilities, and next steps.

  • Renewal and retention performance is strong across the assigned portfolio.

  • Expansion opportunities are identified through customer value and business need rather than transactional selling.

  • Pleo is viewed as a strategic partner rather than simply a product provider.

Candidate profile summary

The strongest candidate for this role is an experienced enterprise Customer Success professional who combines senior-level relationship skills with commercial awareness, analytical thinking, and disciplined account execution.

They have at least three years of direct enterprise experience and are comfortable managing complex customers with multiple stakeholders, high expectations, and significant revenue impact.

They know how to earn executive trust, demonstrate value, predict and prevent churn, maintain accurate forecasts, and mobilise cross-functional teams around customer outcomes. They are proactive, credible, highly organised, and capable of protecting and growing Pleo’s most strategic customer relationships.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Sales Engineer
description:
At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution.

We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints.

With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge?

About the role

We are looking for a sales engineer to join our sales team and drive the frontline of industrial decarbonisation.

This role bridges the technical and commercial worlds. You'll need interpersonal and technical skills to build relationships with process engineers in cement plants and understand their challenges. Analytical skills will be essential to delve deep into complex plant data and work out how Gigaton's AI products can solve their most critical issues.

Building on that, you'll need strategic thinking and commercial awareness to turn your findings into concise, compelling proposals for decision-makers at our customers, from the C-suite down.

Ultimately, you'll build clarity from uncertainty, making sure we agree a shared roadmap with our customers that puts our solutions on track for significant real-world benefits before a contract is signed.

Over time, you’ll help us evolve our sales approach and shape the product by feeding insights and needs from the plant back to the product team, building the foundation for scaling across industries.

Your main responsibilities

  • Be the technical expert on sales calls and visits with cement plants.

  • Build trust with process engineers and plant teams by understanding their specific plant issues and linking them to how we can help.

  • Analyse plant data to identify and evaluate opportunities, then use this analysis to create compelling sales proposals.

  • Lead technical discovery and identify early when a plant does not meet our ICP (ideal customer profile) criteria.

  • Make sure relationships and plant understanding are handed over successfully to the deployment team.

  • Act as a feedback loop into Gigaton’s product and machine learning teams, providing field insights that help shape our product roadmap.

  • Develop and iterate the pre-sales technical process, making it more impactful and more automated each time.

  • Travel to plants and conferences, around one week per month, to understand customer environments and explain the product.

What a great fit looks like

  • Exposure to physical sciences, controls, or heavy industry, such as cement, steel, energy, manufacturing, or similar.

  • Strong analytical skills and an outcome-oriented mindset. You can dig into industrial data, identify root causes, generate potential solutions, and explain their value in dollars and tonnes of CO2.

  • Excellent communication skills. You can build credibility and trust in complex industrial environments with both engineers and board-level stakeholders.

  • Comfortable being the technical voice in the conversation, presenting to senior plant leaders and operators, handling objections, and being challenged on your findings by people who have run kilns for 30 years.

  • Naturally curious and keen to learn about the industry, the technology, and each individual plant. You want to understand the root cause behind every question and objection so you can solve the right problem.

  • Confident in ambiguity and able to field very specific technical questions without getting flustered. You know when you can give your understanding, when you need to go and find the answer, and how to maintain customer confidence in both situations.

  • Willingness to travel regularly.

You’ll excel if

  • You build trust easily. You can connect with plant engineers, listen deeply, and align solutions to their priorities.

  • You’d rather diagnose than pitch. Your first instinct in a plant is to ask a better question, not to open the deck.

  • You thrive in dynamic environments. Fast-paced, ambiguous settings excite you, and you’re motivated by high-impact, mission-driven work.

  • You have experience working in heavy industry, particularly cement, steel, energy, heavy manufacturing, or similar.

Success in This Role Means

  • Plants say yes because the technical case is clear. You build customer confidence that Gigaton can deliver high ROI, helping us hit our revenue goals without losing deals because customers don’t understand or believe in our product and capabilities.

  • Deployments are set up to succeed. We haven’t overpromised to sign a contract, and our pre-contract analysis holds up once the system is live.

  • Process engineers trust and rely on you as a partner in solving problems.

  • Deals don’t stall waiting on a technical answer. Objections get handled quickly, and customers get the answers they need in good time.

    We’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change. Our people come from all walks of life, with different countries, cultures, and experiences, and we think that’s one of our biggest strengths.

    We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels safe, respected, and celebrated. No matter your background, if you’re excited by what we do, we want to hear from you.

The interview process

  1. Talent Partner Screen Call: Meet our talent partner and learn more about Gigaton and the role.

  5. Meet with the CEO: Every new potential hire meets Josh.

We believe hiring is a two-way process. Just as we’ll reference-check candidates before making a final offer, we encourage you to reference-check us by chatting to team members you haven’t yet met. Ask anything. We’ll answer with Concrete Honesty.

Once interviews are done, we’ll move quickly to a decision, and we’re always happy to give feedback at any stage.

🕰️ Flexible working We trust you to know how and when you work best and to work that out with your team.

🌴 30 days of holiday (plus bank holidays). Rest is productive. Take the time you need to recharge

🪙 A generous pension scheme. We’re planning for the future in more ways than one.

Our Operating Principles

↗️ Go Gig or Go Home: High Bar, All In. What we do matters to humanity, to our customers and to each other. We hold ourselves to an extraordinarily high bar and bring the urgency this mission requires.

🏭 Concrete Honesty: Be honest. As concrete forms the foundation of our world, genuine honesty and transparency are the bedrock of our culture.

Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Sujet de stage

Doctrine développe des workflows dédiés aux professionnels du droit pour accélérer et améliorer la gestion de leurs dossiers. Parmi eux, Jobexit accompagne les avocats et juristes en droit social dans la simulation de ruptures du contrat de travail, notamment en calculant les indemnités de départ, les indemnités en cas de contentieux, le calendrier de sortie et les allocations chômage.

Dans un litige, un salarié peut demander plusieurs choses à la fois : des salaires impayés, une indemnité de licenciement, des dommages et intérêts, etc. L'objectif du stage est de permettre à l'utilisateur de saisir et d'organiser toutes ces demandes dans l'application, pour mieux estimer les montants en jeu, préparer la négociation avec la partie adverse et générer automatiquement le récapitulatif final destiné au juge. Ceci peut inclure :

  • Concevoir une interface pour ajouter, modifier et réordonner les demandes d'un dossier, chacune avec son montant, son unité de calcul et son ordre
  • Modéliser les dépendances entre demandes (une demande qui ne s'applique que si une autre est refusée par exemple)
  • Calculer et afficher les montants (du coût pour l’employeur au net empoché par le salarié), pour aider l'utilisateur à évaluer les risques
  • Générer automatiquement un document de synthèse clair et structuré, prêt à être intégré dans les conclusions écrites de l'avocat
  • Et d'autres fonctionnalités !

Le ou la stagiaire participera à la compréhension du besoin utilisateur autour de ces outils (en collaboration avec les équipes produit et les juristes) et à la définition des solutions techniques (en collaboration avec les équipes techniques). Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

 

The team:

You're joining as we reshape the People & Operations Experience team, which brings together ops, payroll, people tech, engagement and internal comms. That makes this a build-and-run role. You'll run payroll from day one and help design how the function works going forward, from processes to tooling to documentation.

 
 

The role

You'll take ownership of French payroll, starting with a proper handover from the colleague who runs it today and building towards running it independently. Alongside it, you'll look after the employee lifecycle: joiners, leavers and everything in between. It's real responsibility, with a team around you.

Your development goes in two directions: continuous improvement of how People Ops works, and a progressive move into Global Payroll (US, UK, Singapore) as your confidence and scope grow. Your arrival also creates room for the whole team to take on bigger things, and that includes you.

 

What you'll do

 

Own French payroll

  • Run the full monthly cycle: data collection, absences and leave, inputs, controls, validation and payslip checks

  • Prepare and submit statutory filings on time (URSSAF, DSN, IJSS/Net-entreprise and other mandatory declarations)

Run the employee lifecycle

  • Help document and improve the processes being rebuilt, and contribute to cross-functional People projects

  • You'll work with Finance, Talent Acquisition, HRBPs, C&B and our provider ADP.

 

What you bring

  • 2–3 years of French payroll experience, with hands-on exposure to the monthly cycle and a readiness to own it

  • Rigour: you close the month on time, without being chased

  • A builder's instinct: you document as you go and like making things work better

Why join us ?

  • A rare, AI-native playground: make a profitable scale-up's operations AI-native, with agents in production and visible weekly impact, backed by best-in-class tools (Claude, internal agentic tooling, dedicated observability) and an AI-assisted engineering culture.

  • DevOps-fluent: end-to-end deployment, infra-as-code, and debugging network environments (VPN, proxies).
  • Agents & LLMs: hands-on experience shipping agents to production (ADK, LangChain, or similar), including applied prompt engineering and evaluation.

title: Senior Demande Generation Manager
description:
About Scality

Scality builds data infrastructure software for enterprise AI, cyber resilience, and sovereign control at multi-petabyte to exabyte scale. Its AI Data Infrastructure platform reduces operational burden through AI-powered autonomous operations while aligning the right storage media, performance, and protection to each workload through human-approved lifecycle policies.
 
Built on CORE5 cyber resilience and open-code principles, Scality software delivers extreme performance, operational simplicity, and sustainable economics. 
 
The world's most demanding enterprises and government organizations depend on Scality to power AI initiatives, defend critical data, and build infrastructure that lasts for decades. Recognized as a leader by Gartner, Scality is where AI remembers, learns, and thinks. F
 
ollow us on LinkedIn. Visit www.scality.com and our blog.

About the role
Scality is looking for an experienced Demand Generation Campaign Manager to own our global campaign program. You plan, launch, and optimize the campaigns that generate qualified leads and opportunities across our enterprise and mid-market go to market in the Americas, EMEA, and Asia Pacific.
 
This is a hands-on role for a marketer who thinks strategically. You take a pipeline target, decide how to reach it, and run the campaigns that get there. You hold yourself to the numbers: leads and opportunities generated, conversion by stage, cost per lead and per opportunity, and channel efficiency. Most of the work is digital. You also run the campaigns around our webinars, trade shows, and partner programs, from promotion to lead follow up.
 
The main challenge is generating demand in a market that is changing fast. Buyers increasingly get their information from AI tools rather than the channels marketers have relied on, and gated content and volume downloads are losing their effect. This role needs the creativity to build demand where the old playbooks no longer work.

You own the campaign function in an international marketing team. You work closely with the Head of Growth, who runs paid media, SEO, and web, and with marketing operations and nurture. You work with the AMER field marketing manager and the EMEA regional marketing team on campaigns for their events and partner programs, and with product marketing on messaging and assets. You also work with sales, SDR, and partner teams in every region.

What you will be doing
  • Own the global campaign plan and calendar, translating pipeline targets into integrated campaigns across paid social, paid search, email, webinars, content syndication, and account-based marketing
  • Take each campaign from brief to launch: audience and targeting, offer, messaging with product marketing, landing pages and forms, promotion, lead routing, and reporting
  • Run campaigns for webinars, trade shows, field events, and partner programs, from promotion before the event to lead follow up after
  • Run the thought leadership and customer webinar program, from topic and speakers to registration, delivery, and follow up
  • Work with the Head of Growth on paid media strategy, spend allocation, and experimentation across LinkedIn, Google, and new channels
  • Build campaigns with marketing operations in HubSpot and Salesforce, and own campaign structure, naming, and attribution in Salesforce
  • Own weekly and monthly lead generation reporting to marketing and executive leadership: leads and opportunities against goal, conversion by stage, cost per lead and per opportunity, and spend by channel and region
  • Align with sales and SDR teams across regions on lead handoff, follow up, and pipeline acceleration
  • Manage campaign budgets and agencies, and prioritize spend against pipeline impact
  • Run experiments across audiences, offers, and channels to improve conversion and lower acquisition cost

    • What you bring to the table
  • Ten years or more of experience in lead generation, demand generation, or digital marketing, running integrated campaigns end to end
  • International experience: you have run campaigns across several regions, ideally including the US, and understand how buyers and channels differ by market
  • Experience in B2B enterprise software, ideally in storage, data management, backup, or adjacent data infrastructure markets
  • A track record of campaigns that produced measurable pipeline, with the numbers to back it up
  • Hands-on experience with paid social and paid search, and with webinar and event campaigns 
  • Strong command of HubSpot and Salesforce and of campaign analytics
  • The ability to shape a plan from a pipeline target while staying hands on in execution
  • The creativity to generate demand where buyers rely on AI over traditional channels and gated content no longer carries the funnel
  • Native or near-native English, written and spoken. You write campaign copy for US and international audiences
  • Comfort working with colleagues across time zones, with regular overlap with the US team in the afternoon

    • Life at Scality
  • We offer careers with an opportunity to bridge international borders, an intensely fun environment with smart people.
  • We encourage promotion and elevation through training and development programs.
  • We care for our employees through company supported programs such as sports and wellness programs, social responsibility programs, and generous benefits packages.
  • We support team building and get together events across all of our locations around the world.
  • Life at Scality is exhilarating. Our internal motto is: work hard, play hard, eat well and amaze the customer!

description:
Qui sommes-nous ? 

 

Q ENERGY France est un acteur majeur du marché des énergies renouvelables en France. Autrefois affilié au groupe RES, l’entreprise œuvre depuis 27 ans dans le développement, la construction et l’exploitation de projets éoliens et photovoltaïques.  

Aujourd'hui également positionnée sur le marché du stockage d'énergie, Q ENERGY poursuit son expansion vers de nouveaux domaines afin de proposer des solutions intelligentes et complètes pour la production et la fourniture d’énergie durable en France. 

L'entreprise compte près de 300 collaborateur.rice.s et 6 agences sur le territoire ainsi qu'un siège social basé à Avignon. Q ENERGY France est une entreprise de la holding européenne Q ENERGY Solutions, créée en 2021 par Hanwha Solutions dans l'objectif de conduire à la prochaine génération de production d'énergie verte et flexible en Europe. Basée à Berlin, Q ENERGY Solutions est une société sœur de Q CELLS, fabricant de modules photovoltaïques reconnu à travers le monde. Les deux sociétés constituent la division Energie du groupe Hanwha Solutions, basé à Séoul. 

 

 

Vos missions : 

 

Rattaché.e au Responsable Asset Management and O&M, vous aurez pour objectifs d'analyser les performances des centrales éoliennes, photovoltaïques et de stockage et d'en garantir la fiabilité des données. 

 

Vos missions principales seront :  

 

  • Collaborer avec les gestionnaires d’actifs (Asset Managers) pour suivre et analyser les performances des parcs éoliens, photovoltaïques et des systèmes de stockage en exploitation.  
  • Garantir l’intégrité des données collectées, les analyser et les partager afin d’assurer une gestion efficace des tableaux de bord.  
  • Travailler avec les différents départements de Q ENERGY afin d’optimiser la rentabilité de nos projets éoliens, solaires et de stockage ainsi que la performance des centrales.  
  • Mettre en place des tableaux de bord automatisés à destination des parties prenantes.  
  • Administrer les bases de données et exploiter les outils MySQL et Power BI.  
  • Assurer le support dans la gestion quotidienne des données ainsi que dans la création des politiques et autorisations d’accès.  
  • Être responsable de l’historisation SCADA et des plateformes de supervision.  
  • Assurer la supervision des systèmes SCADA et des réseaux, réaliser les diagnostics SCADA, détecter les anomalies et les corriger pendant la phase d’exploitation.  
  • Être le référent technique pour toutes les questions liées au SCADA et à la gestion des installations éoliennes, photovoltaïques et de stockage en exploitation.  
  • Collaborer avec les équipes Développement, Achats et Construction afin d’améliorer les outils de suivi et de partager les bonnes pratiques.

  • Déclaration des non-conformités et participation à la mise en place d’actions correctives 
  • Participation aux actions et projets d’amélioration continue et de partage des savoirs 

Requirements

De formation ingénieur généraliste, vous disposez de solides compétences techniques et aimez évoluer dans des environnements à la croisée de plusieurs expertises.

title: Head of Formal Verification (m/f/d)
description:
Your mission

You own the direction of our formal verification business. Our managers keep delivery predictable. You decide what the organisation becomes.

You report to the CEO and are a member of the executive leadership team. You carry the FV consulting business as a whole — where it goes, how it performs, who leads it — and you answer for it. You will not solve verification problems, and you will rarely run a project or an account yourself. Concretely, you own:

title: Quantum Information Scientist - Architecture & Performance
description:
About Quandela:

Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers.
Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.
Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Our ambition is to build large-scale fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of solving problems beyond the reach of classical computation. 

Getting there will require several generations of intermediate architectures. Choosing the right ones means understanding what can be built, what these systems can compute and how efficiently they can do so.

About this position:

You will join Quandela’s Quantum Information team within Architecture, working on the evaluation and design of our near- and mid-term quantum architectures. 

Your role will sit between quantum theory, computational capability and real hardware constraints. You will develop methods to evaluate architecture concepts, understand their performance and limitations, and help guide future architecture choices.

Depending on your background, you may draw on complexity theory, quantum learning theory, quantum-system characterisation, benchmarking or related areas. You will work closely with our Device Physics, FTQC and Q.Algorithms Team.

Requirements

What you'll do:

As a Quantum Information Scientist working on Architecture & Performance, you will: 

  • Evaluate and compare the capabilities and limitations of near- and mid-term quantum architectures. 
  • Draw on methods from complexity theory, benchmarking, characterisation and related fields to assess different architecture designs. 
  • Incorporate realistic noise, native operations and physical constraints into your analyses. 
  • Investigate when and how different architectures could provide meaningful computational capabilities or advantages. 
  • Develop scientific models and numerical tools to explore architecture-performance trade-offs. 
  • Study how architecture choices interact with algorithms, resource requirements and QEC strategies. 
  • Progressively propose and lead new research projects around architecture design and performance. 

You will work across our Architecture team and Algorithms and Applications team, connecting questions from the physical layer to computational capability and potential applications. 
-

How you'll grow:

During your first 3–6 months 
Become familiar with Quandela’s technologies, architecture roadmap and ongoing research while contributing to existing evaluation and performance studies. 

Within 1 year 
Take increasing ownership of architecture studies, compare different concepts and bring your own scientific perspective to the team. 

Longer term 
Lead exploratory research projects, propose new architecture directions and contribute to shaping Quandela’s future architecture roadmap.

--

What we're looking for:
We are looking for a scientist with a strong theoretical background in quantum computing, scientific autonomy and an interest in connecting different layers of the quantum-computing stack.

Must-have 

  • PhD in Quantum Information, Quantum Computing, Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a closely related field. 
  • Strong expertise in one or more relevant areas, such as quantum complexity theory, quantum learning theory, quantum-system characterisation, performance analysis or quantum algorithms. 
  • Experience connecting theoretical or computational questions with realistic implementation, hardware or experimental constraints. 
  • Ability to assess the capabilities and limitations of quantum systems or architectures. 
  • Experience with scientific modelling, numerical simulation and Python-based scientific computing. 
  • Scientific autonomy and ability to structure open-ended research problems.
  • Collaborative and personable, with the ability to communicate ideas clearly to people from other fields of expertise.
  • Professional English. 

Important, but you can grow here 

  • Quantum Error Correction and early fault-tolerant architectures.
  • Hardware-aware algorithm or architecture design. 
  • Quantum benchmarking and performance metrics. 
  • Noise modelling. 
  • Resource and computational-cost analysis. 
  • Collaboration with experimental or hardware-oriented quantum-computing teams. 

Bonus 

  • Quantum compilation or native-gate-aware circuit design. 
  • Photonic quantum computing. 
  • Resource estimation. 
  • Experience comparing quantum approaches against strong classical baselines. 
  • Previous ownership of collaborative research projects. 

You do not need to cover every topic above. We welcome both candidates with postdoctoral or equivalent industrial R&D experience and strong recent PhDs demonstrating scientific autonomy.

Benefits

Join a growing quantum-computing company and contribute directly to the research behind future generations of quantum architectures. 

  • Explore open scientific questions grounded in real hardware constraints. 
  • Work across Quantum Information, Device Physics, FTQC and Algorithms. 
  • Take ownership of broad and exploratory research projects. 
  • Contribute to the scientific directions of a growing team. 

Plus: 

  • Competitive compensation aligned with your experience and level of responsibility. 
  • Company savings plan.
  • 100% health coverage through Alan. 
  • Transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus. 
  • Swile meal vouchers. 
  • Access to Gymlib. 

Process 

  • Talent Acquisition interview, 30–45 min
  • Interview with Quantum Information hiring manager, 30-45 min
  • Presentation of previous research work and discussion with members of the theory team 
  • Reference checks 
  • Technical discussion based on a scientific paper or research topic
  • Offer 

For the technical exercise, you may be asked to explore scientific material outside your direct area of expertise and discuss how you would connect it to a broader architecture problem.

title: Key Account Manager — Treasury Expert
description:
About Agicap

Créée à Lyon en 2016 par trois entrepreneurs français, Agicap est l'une des scale-ups avec la plus forte croissance d’Europe, avec plus de 8 000 clients, 600 employés et une croissance rapide du chiffre d'affaires (multiplié par 7 entre 2021 et 2024). Agicap fait partie du French Tech 120, qui récompense les startups les plus prometteuses de France.

Agicap permet aux directions financières des entreprises de taille intermédiaire de gérer et de prévoir efficacement leur trésorerie, de payer leurs fournisseurs et de se faire payer. En combinant un système de gestion de trésorerie avec des solutions de gestion des comptes fournisseurs et des comptes clients sur une seule plateforme, Agicap ambitionne de devenir la nouvelle référence en matière de gestion de trésorerie pour les entreprises de taille intermédiaire.

Nous avons levé 145 millions d’euros depuis notre création, auprès de fonds de capital-risque prestigieux tels qu’AVP, Greenoaks, Partech et BlackFin, avec un dernier tour en novembre 2024.

Ces ressources supplémentaires alimentent encore davantage notre innovation produit, nous permettant de croître significativement et d’accélérer notre expansion internationale à travers le monde.

Nous sommes convaincus que notre succès réside dans nos équipes passionnées et dévouées, engagées à bâtir une entreprise où chacun peut évoluer et construire sa carrière. Nous sommes constamment à la recherche de nouveaux talents, visant l’excellence et prêts à rejoindre notre aventure ambitieuse !

Home page
Customer Stories
Our Values

⚡️ Le rôle

Agicap est en pleine phase de scale-up : nous signons chaque mois de nombreux nouveaux clients, et développer et fidéliser nos clients existants est désormais tout aussi important. L'expansion et le churn font partie des premiers indicateurs suivis par notre board.

En tant que Key Account Manager, vous êtes responsable d'un portefeuille d'environ 150 comptes mid-market : des entreprises de plus de 50 M€ de chiffre d'affaires, souvent des groupes multi-entités, des sociétés en hypercroissance ou détenues par des fonds de private equity. Vous travaillez avec des DAF, directeur·rices financier·ères, trésorier·ères, responsables comptables et parfois des CEO.

Ce qui rend ce poste unique : vous apportez une vraie expertise en trésorerie. Vous ne vous contentez pas de comprendre les enjeux des équipes finance (maîtriser les prévisions de trésorerie, améliorer la performance financière, assurer la gestion quotidienne des paiements et de la liquidité, gérer la relation bancaire, intégrer et piloter toutes les entités d'un groupe) : vous savez les challenger. Vous êtes un·e véritable conseiller·ère de confiance pour vos clients.

Vous rejoignez une équipe de 7 KAM qui a obtenu d'excellents résultats cette année, avec un fort esprit d'équipe et des objectifs ambitieux.


🎯 Vos missions

🤝 Construire des relations solides avec les décideur·ses finance

  • Instaurer une relation de confiance avec les décideur·ses de vos comptes et cartographier toutes les parties prenantes clés, souvent sur plusieurs entités
  • Comprendre leur contexte business, leur organisation trésorerie, leurs process et leurs priorités, et les challenger avec les bonnes pratiques adaptées
  • Gérer les frictions et les situations complexes avec assurance

    • 📈 Développer votre portefeuille

    • Définir et piloter une stratégie de développement pour chaque compte : upsell, renouvellement, contrats pluriannuels, recommandation
    • Identifier de nouvelles opportunités : nouvelles entités, nouveaux cas d'usage, évolutions dans l'organisation ou le contexte business du client
    • Mener des découvertes et des démos produit centrées sur les cas d'usage trésorerie, construire des business cases et négocier les offres
    • Porter vos objectifs mensuels d'expansion et de rétention

      • 📊 Démontrer la valeur et sécuriser la rétention

      • Animer des Executive Business Reviews (EBR) pour vous aligner sur les enjeux stratégiques du client et mesurer son retour sur investissement
      • Détecter tôt les signaux faibles de churn et sauver les comptes à risque
      • Suivre et analyser votre performance avec votre manager pour progresser en continu

        • 🔗 Être la voix de la trésorerie chez Agicap

        • Trouver le bon équilibre entre la mise en avant du produit et le bon timing : notre produit évolue vite, à vous de fixer les bonnes attentes avec vos clients
        • Identifier les besoins d'activation ou de paramétrage et les transmettre à l'équipe Onboarding
        • Partager vos retours terrain avec les équipes CS et Produit pour améliorer nos process et notre produit

👀 Votre profil
  • Vous avez une solide expertise en trésorerie / cash management, acquise en direction trésorerie, en conseil, en banque ou chez un éditeur de logiciels trésorerie / finance
  • Vous savez expliquer et challenger des sujets comme les prévisions de trésorerie, le BFR, le cash pooling, la connectivité bancaire ou la consolidation multi-entités
  • Vous avez fait vos preuves dans un rôle client avec des objectifs commerciaux (account management, upsell, renouvellements ou business development), et vous savez mener une bonne découverte
  • Vous êtes à l'aise avec des décideur·ses finance exigeant·es et vous savez conduire des négociations complexes
  • Vous êtes moteur de votre propre montée en compétences : résilient·e, vous aimez résoudre des problèmes et vous vous remettez en question en permanence
  • Vous êtes à l'aise dans un environnement qui va vite, où tout n'est pas encore parfait
  • Vous avez un fort esprit d'équipe et vous aimez partager vos connaissances
  • Vous parlez couramment français et anglais

    • ⭐️ Bonus : une expérience sur un TMS ou un ERP (Kyriba, SAP, Sage, Cegid…), une connaissance de l'environnement SaaS, de la rigueur dans l'utilisation d'un CRM (HubSpot / Salesforce)


🔥 Pourquoi rejoindre Agicap ?
  • Mettre votre expertise trésorerie au cœur d'un rôle commercial, avec un produit conçu pour les équipes finance
  • Rejoindre une équipe à fort impact, dans une phase clé de structuration : un gros challenge et une vraie contribution à apporter
  • Un package fixe + variable, qui récompense à la fois l'expansion et la rétention — à confirmer

title: Sales Enablement Manager - France
description:
À propos de Lexroom

Chez Lexroom, nous développons l'état de l'art de la recherche juridique agentique. Notre plateforme décompose chaque question juridique en sous-questions précises, puis mobilise des agents spécialisés pour explorer en parallèle les codes, jurisprudences, doctrines et textes européens. Chaque source est minutieusement analysée, les liens implicites entre principes sont identifiés, et toutes les informations sont synthétisées dans un rapport structuré, avec chaque affirmation soigneusement sourcée. Ce qui, auparavant, demandait une semaine à une équipe se réalise désormais pendant une pause café.

Notre mission : rendre le droit plus rapide, plus clair et plus fiable, afin que les avocats et les directions juridiques puissent se concentrer sur l'essentiel.

Nous construisons l'équipe commerciale en France, et nous cherchons la personne qui va la former, l'accompagner et la faire monter en compétence à travers la Lexroom Sales Academy.

Pourquoi rejoindre Lexroom ?

  • Un produit qui tient ses promesses : nos démos sont impactantes et convainquent dès la première session, pas besoin de six mois de POC.

  • Un marché en pleine effervescence : tous les cabinets français recherchent une solution IA, et les usages sont encore à inventer.

  • Un avantage concurrentiel fort : vous ne formez pas des commerciaux à vendre un assistant IA de plus, mais une approche radicalement nouvelle que les prospects n'ont jamais vue.

  • Un impact direct : la qualité de l'équipe commerciale française dépendra de ce que vous construisez.

Vos responsabilités

  • Piloter la Lexroom Sales Academy en France : concevoir et animer des programmes de formation récurrents (onboarding, ramp-up, formation avancée), avec objectifs, contenus, calendrier et indicateurs de succès.

  • Gérer l'onboarding des nouvelles recrues commerciales : première semaine et deux premiers mois de ramp-up, en coordonnant agendas, supports, intervenants internes et exercices pratiques.

  • Animer vous-même les modules de formation : méthodologie de vente, discovery, démos, traitement des objections, négociation, gestion du pipeline, avec role-plays, coaching sur les appels et feedback structuré.

  • Maintenir les contenus à jour : playbooks, scripts, templates et supports de l'Academy, en phase avec l'évolution du produit, du marché et des performances de l'équipe. Transformer les succès internes (appels, emails, séquences, deals complexes) en ressources de formation réutilisables.

  • Travailler main dans la main avec les Sales Managers et les AE pour que la formation se traduise concrètement dans le pipeline, les appels et les démos.

  • Aligner l'Academy France avec les initiatives globales et adapter au marché français les best practices déjà éprouvées en Italie.

Profil recherché

  • Expérience en management commercial, sales enablement ou gestion de projet en environnement B2B (idéalement SaaS, tech ou conseil).

  • Solide mindset PMO : capacité à transformer des besoins en plans structurés, aligner les parties prenantes, tenir les délais, livrer et mesurer l'impact.

  • À l'aise aussi bien en animation (formations, ateliers, role-plays) que dans le travail de détail sur les process, les contenus et les métriques.

  • Excellentes compétences en communication, résolution de problèmes et collaboration transverse.

  • Très opérationnel : vous ne vous contentez pas de concevoir des programmes, vous participez aux appels, analysez les chiffres et itérez vite.

  • Français natif, anglais courant (équipes internes internationales).

  • Intérêt pour le droit : une expérience dans le secteur juridique ou des services professionnels est un plus, mais pas indispensable.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Rémunération fixe: 80 k€ brut annuel + variable sur objectifs

  • Equity

  • Mutuelle Alan, titres-restaurant, accès Wellpass (sport et bien-être)

  • Travail hybride, bureaux à Paris

  • Team retreats et off-sites

title: Security Engineer (Hybrid or Remote)
description:
About The Role

We’re looking for a Security Engineer to own and improve the security of our internal environment — the identities, SaaS apps, endpoints, AI tooling, and networks our employees use every day. This is a hands-on senior role: we expect you to design controls, find the gaps, and drive the changes that close them — and to build the automation that makes it scale.

We’re an EMI-licensed fintech in a fully cloud-native AWS environment, we use AI heavily, and we’re growing fast. We need someone who can lead technical initiatives independently, influence our security architecture, challenge approaches that no longer fit, and explain it clearly to engineers and leadership.


Your Mission

Detection & Response (SIEM) — our top priority

  • Own SIEM alerting end-to-end: ship logs from endpoints, IdP, VPN, SaaS, and cloud; write and tune detection rules; cut false positives.
  • Act as first responder for security incidents — investigate, contain, drive to closure with clear runbooks — and feed recurring issues back into preventive controls.
Identity, Access & SaaS
  • Administer the IdP (SSO via SAML/OIDC, MFA, conditional access) and run access recertification end-to-end across IdP, SaaS, AWS, and internal tools — scope, evidence, follow-through on revocations.
  • Hunt down over-permissive and stale access, enforce least privilege and PAM, catch SoD gaps, and make JML and third-party access work in practice.
  • Improve SaaS security posture (Google/Microsoft, Slack, GitHub, others) and apply DLP controls to limit data leakage.
Endpoint, Email & Phishing Defense
  • Keep the endpoint stack healthy and well-tuned — MDM, XDR/AV, device-compliance checks for VPN/ZTNA — and define posture requirements (disk encryption, EDR present, OS version) with automated remediation.
  • Defend against phishing and spoofing — secure email gateway rules, DMARC/SPF/DKIM — and run phishing simulations and security awareness, acting on the results.
Automation & Ownership
  • Build internal tooling and automate repetitive operations — reduce manual work, don't just operate it.
  • Own the roadmap for your areas: identify gaps, lead initiatives independently, and raise the bar rather than just maintain it.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years in security operations, corporate/IT security, or endpoint engineering.
  • Strong with a SIEM (Splunk, Elastic, Panther, Sumo Logic) — detection engineering and incident response — plus an identity provider (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace), access recertification, and least-privilege / PAM.
  • Working knowledge of endpoint security (MDM, XDR/EDR/AV) and email / phishing defense.
  • Practical experience securing how a company uses AI internally: shadow AI discovery, DLP for AI tools, controls for AI assistants and agents, and a working risk framework for adopting new ones. You've done this for real, not from a vendor pitch deck.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills — you build tooling against APIs, not just configure consoles.
  • Track record of driving improvements end-to-end and leading initiatives with little oversight. 
  • Сlear written and spoken English for engineers and leadership.


Why Join Vivid?

  • We have a hybrid model in our Limassol office, or fully remote outside office locations. 
  • We support relocation to Cyprus (visa, package) when needed.
  • Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. 
  • Fully paid vacation and sick leave. 
  • Sports compensation. 
  • Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one. 
Enhance your expertise and shape the future of FinTech. Join Vivid's talented team and help us revolutionize how businesses think about their finances!


Compensation range

Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.


About Vivid

At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.

Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started. 

We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

title: Senior Project Manager (m/f/d)
description:
Role description

As Senior Project Manager, you will join our central Project Management team in Reinbek, which leads the company's large and complex cross-functional projects and sets the standards for how projects are run across all of arethia's global locations. Join us during a pivotal growth phase and help create the foundations of a team that will drive meaningful transformation across the organisation.

You will independently lead complex projects with senior stakeholders across departments, and you will be the person we turn to when a project has drifted off course and needs to be brought back on track. 

This is a delivery role first, and it is also a chance to shape how project management works in a growing, international company: you will contribute to our standards and methods, support colleagues who run their own projects and help build a project management community across our sites. As the team grows, so does the scope of what you can take on.


Your Mission

  • Project Leadership – Lead large, cross-functional projects independently from initiation to closure, including planning, governance, steering committees and stakeholder management.
  • Problem Solving - Facilitate and actively participate in problem-solving sessions to drive project success 
  • Project Recovery – Take over projects that have drifted off course or lost their lead, diagnose what went wrong and re-establish structure as interim or permanent lead.
  • Stakeholder Management – Navigate demanding situations with senior leadership and across departments and prepare well-founded decisions for steering committees.
  • Quality and Coaching – Support department-led projects as quality assurance and sparring partner and coach project managers on their deliverables.
  • Standards and Methods – Contribute to our project management standards, templates and training formats, and turn project experience into reusable methods.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Several years of experience independently leading complex, cross-functional projects with full ownership from initiation to closure.
  • Experience working with senior stakeholders and navigating conflicting interests across departments.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
  • Experience taking over or stabilising projects already in progress.
  • Ability to work independently, propose solutions and make decisions within your remit.
  • Business-level communication skills in German and English (C1).
  • Experience in applying common project management tools, e.g. for task and milestone tracking.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with an ERP or comparable large-scale system implementation.
  • IPMA Level C or equivalent. A higher level is a plus.
  • Experience in a manufacturing or regulated production environment.
  • Experience developing project management standards, templates or training formats.
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence.
  • Experience working in an international, multi-site organisation.


Why you'll love working here

  • Exciting tasks in an internationally operating, growing family business with flat hierarchies
  • Flexible working hours and a hybrid working model
  • 4 weeks remote work from other EU countries
  • 30 days paid vacation per year
  • Salary bands for a fair corporate culture
  • Monthly allowance of €50 for your BAV
  • Annual 360° feedback loops with clear promotion criteria and an individual career path
  • Responsibility from day one in a company that encourages personal responsibility and growth
  • Relocation costs can be reimbursed on a pro rata basis
  • Regular company events such as summer party, Christmas party
  • Paid team dinners or activities for each team twice a year
  • Free parking right outside the door
  • Perks and benefits: JobRad, subsidized lunch, subsidy for the Deutschlandticket, free language courses and discounted memberships at several gyms and for the Wellpass
  • Fresh fruit, free drinks and snacks in the office

title: (Senior) Account Executive - France
description:
Position Overview:

This is a vacancy for a hybrid role based at our coworking office in Paris (9th arrondissement, Opéra). We encourage applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender identity. You will be on-site in Paris 2 days per week for close collaboration and alignment; the remaining 3 days can be worked remotely.

We're a small, fast-moving French team backed by a German HQ. We need someone genuinely entrepreneurial who thrives on ownership rather than process, and who is both commercially sharp and technically curious – a strong communicator able to translate technical value into business outcomes.

Ready to make an impact?


You’ll get to take ownership of:

  • Full sales cycle: owning qualification through close on the French market. Typical deals run €33–40k ACV, with occasional enterprise opportunities above €150k.
  • Net-new business in a lean setup: driving new-logo pipeline generation in a 3-person French sales team, where sourcing outside your own network matters as much as closing.
  • Partner-led scaling: building and activating the strategic partner ecosystem (Hardis, Horus, Acelys, CGI, Devoteam) as a lever for sourcing and co-selling – partner-sourced deals count at a 1.2× accelerator toward quota.
  • Technically credible selling: running discovery and value conversations around data integration, EDI and IT/SI architecture, engaging both business and technical stakeholders (IT, architecture, CISO).
  • Cross-functional deal-shaping: working closely with Sales Engineering and Partnerships on complex, multi-stakeholder deals, RFPs and consortia.


We’d love to meet someone with:

  • Proven track record: consistently closing software/SaaS deals with a documented win history – not just pipeline.
  • New-logo generation: a track record of opening new business outside your own existing network, through mapping, partners, events or an installed base.
  • Technical affinity: strong understanding of data, integration and IT system architecture; able to hold your own in a technical discovery conversation.
  • Industry knowledge: domain exposure to logistics, supply chain, retail, manufacturing, automotive or pharma.
  • Scale-up selling: experience in a small / scale-up structure – high autonomy, hands-on, comfortable without heavy sales infrastructure.
  • Partner / channel selling: demonstrated success selling through or with strategic partners and system integrators (co-sell, ecosystem-led growth).
  • Languages: French native or bilingual; professional/fluent English (internal working language; HQ in Germany). 


You can look forward to:

  • No closed territories – this is a meritocracy: the more you win, the more scope you get.
  • Uncapped variable compensation, with quotas designed to be achievable.
  • An AI-equipped sales workflow, including deal coaching and prospecting support.
  • Direct access to the Head of France and to how decisions get made.
  • A coworking office in Paris (Opéra)
  • A personal learning and development budget
  • 30 vacation days per year
  • Up to 20 days of remote work per year from any EU country
  • Opportunity to work flexibly from home

If you're excited about this role but don't meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply! 

Lobster is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive environment where empathy and respect guide our interactions.

description:
Do you want to work for the global leader in the language services and technology industry? Are you interested in helping international brands/organizations find and implement solutions that allow them to communicate, operate and sell their products and services efficiently and effectively? And are you the type of person who enjoys an integrity focused, fast-paced, entrepreneurial, innovative, vibrant environment? Then we'd like to hear from you!

TransPerfect was founded with a mission to help the world's businesses navigate the global marketplace. Today, we have grown to be an industry leader organization by helping clients globalize their business no matter what service they might need. TransPerfect provides a full array of language and business support services, including translation, subtitling and dubbing, multicultural marketing, website globalization, legal support, and any kind of technology solution.

That’s enough about us – what about you? We look for and appreciate anyone who is willing to roll up their sleeves and get stuck in! We offer a fast growth path for career and personal development and provide full training around our services, technology solutions and workflows. Therefore the key skills we are looking for are solid communication and relationship building abilities, keeping a cool head under pressure and really owning your role, taking responsibility for your clients and their business success.

TransPerfect is looking for established sales professionals to further develop our engagement model. The Director of Business Development will be responsible for identifying and engaging with client prospects as well as managing client relationships during the full life cycle of client campaigns. Minimum 3 years experience in a similar role required.

Key position responsibilities:

  • Source and close new clients through referrals, cold calling, networking, and other means (tradeshows, regional organizations, etc.)

  • Build a productive pipeline and manage each phase of the sales process

  • Cultivate and maintain long term relationships with clients by delivering elite client service and engaging them by using knowledge of each industry and organization

  • Formulate sales plan to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets

  • Generate daily outreach efforts (direct mail, digital marketing, cold calls) to prospective clients

  • Develop an effective understanding of the capabilities, benefits, and competitive advantages of TransPerfect's services

  • Present TransPerfect's solutions via one-on-one, group, online and in-person meetings

  • Set and manage client expectations while consulting with each client for best practices

  • Manage and control pricing and contractual issues

  • Travel (including multiple annual conferences, client meetings) - domestic and/or international


Essential skills required:

  • Commit to a high level of integrity and service

  • Deliver quality work

  • Service focused with a desire to exceed clients’ expectations

  • Owning your performance and taking responsibility

  • Multitask and work with a sense of urgency in a fast-paced environment

  • Commit to always treating everyone (from clients to co-workers to vendors to business partners) with the ultimate level of respect

  • Work well in a team with people from a variety of different backgrounds and cultures

  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with clients and co-workers

  • Celebrate diversity and embrace new ideas and differing perspectives

  • Be financially responsible and make sound financial decisions

  • Take active measures to achieve results and solve problems

Essential experience required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience

  • Minimum 3 years successful sales experience

  • Superior written and spoken communication skills in German and English

  • Familiarity and ability to communicate value and competitive advantages

title: Infrastructure Software Engineer
description:
Join our mission

We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products.

We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run.

After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective.

Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster.

About the role

Namespace's approach is low-friction, designed for immediate integration into existing developer toolchains, empowering teams to experience tangible results within just five minutes. With an end-to-end stack optimized for high performance—including compute, memory, storage, and networking—Namespace delivers capabilities and efficiencies unmatched by traditional cloud providers.

Own the software that drives our hardware. You'll write the control planes, automation, and observability that keep our global fleet fast, efficient, and reliable, while charting a path to scale that continues to increase the number of "machines under management" per engineer.

Our culture

We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved. Most importantly, you have a strong bias to execution: you don't wait for perfect conditions, you ship, learn, and iterate quickly. If you care about building, moving fast, and making real impact, you'll fit right in.

What you'll do

  • Manage and automate the fleet – build services for provisioning, health checks, upgrades, and incident remediation

  • Uphold reliability – embed observability, graceful degradation, and rollback paths into every layer you touch

  • Architect the network – design and evolve a high-throughput, low-latency fabric tailored to our high performance use-cases

  • Ship software, not scripts – develop clean, testable code (mostly Go) that treats our fleet like a first-class API

  • Drive efficiency – improve utilization and power-to-performance ratios so capacity grows slower than usage

  • Partner across the stack – work with product, infra, and platform teams to scope and deliver features like storage-aware scheduling, cache volumes, and other developer-facing features

What we're looking for

  • Proven experience engineering large-scale infrastructure - writing the software that runs fleets, not just operating existing hyperscalers

  • Depth in network architecture, data-center design, and performance tuning

  • Hands-on time deploying and managing compute hardware at scale (servers, switches, etc)

  • Fluency with modern orchestration and automation tooling (Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible - plus the judgment to know when to build vs. buy)

  • A track record of delivering reliable systems and measurable efficiency gains

You can expect:

  • Competitive salary and stock options

  • Flexible working hours

  • Market-leading parental leave

Life at Namespace Labs:

  • We pride ourselves in being a small team of experts that can achieve a lot.

  • We balance our long-term vision with short-term pragmatism.

  • We believe in being fully transparent internally on how decisions are made, on how the company is doing, and we use that information to drive our decisions.
